create_NaiveTNT_block: create a NaiveTNT curvature block for estimating Kronecker-factored Fisher information of a single parameter or weights plus bias
update_NaiveTNT_curvature: update the NaiveTNT curvature matrix estimate by contracting summed gradients and dividing by batch size
create_DenseTNT_block: create a DenseTNT curvature block for dense layers that averages per-example contractions for lower variance estimation
update_DenseTNT_curvature: update the DenseTNT curvature estimate by weighting inputs and outputs with each other's norms before computing covariances
create_Conv2DTNT_block: create a Conv2DTNT curvature block for Conv2D layers using location-independent spatial averaging of per-example gradient contractions
